From 8541323285994528ad5be2c1bdc759e6c83b936e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2024 21:05:14 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] iommufd: Add missing IOMMUFD_DRIVER kconfig for the selftest

Some kconfigs don't automatically include this symbol which results in sub
functions for some of the dirty tracking related things that are
non-functional. Thus the test suite will fail. select IOMMUFD_DRIVER in
the IOMMUFD_TEST kconfig to fix it.

Fixes: a9af47e382a4 ("iommufd/selftest: Test IOMMU_HWPT_GET_DIRTY_BITMAP")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240327182050.GA1363414@ziepe.ca
Tested-by: Muhammad Usama Anjum <usama.anjum@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/iommu/iommufd/Kconfig b/drivers/iommu/iommufd/Kconfig
index 99d4b075df49..76656fe0470d 100644
--- a/drivers/iommu/iommufd/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/iommu/iommufd/Kconfig
@@ -37,6 +37,7 @@ config IOMMUFD_TEST
 	depends on DEBUG_KERNEL
 	depends on FAULT_INJECTION
 	depends on RUNTIME_TESTING_MENU
+	select IOMMUFD_DRIVER
 	default n
 	help
 	  This is dangerous, do not enable unless running
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/iommu/iommufd/Kconfig`**
   - A new line was added to the `IOMMUFD_TEST` configuration option:
     ```plaintext
     + select IOMMUFD_DRIVER
     ```
   - This modification ensures that the `IOMMUFD_DRIVER` symbol is automatically included when the `IOMMUFD_TEST` configuration is enabled.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The addition of `select IOMMUFD_DRIVER` in the `IOMMUFD_TEST` configuration establishes a dependency that ensures the necessary driver functionality is available for the self-test suite. This change addresses a bug where certain sub-functions related to dirty tracking were non-functional, leading to failures in the test suite. By making this selection, the patch ensures that the required components are included, thus fixing the issue referenced in the commit message.

Here is the commit message:
iommufd: Add missing IOMMUFD_DRIVER kconfig for the selftest

Some kconfigs don't automatically include this symbol which results in sub
functions for some of the dirty tracking related things that are
non-functional. Thus the test suite will fail. select IOMMUFD_DRIVER in
the IOMMUFD_TEST kconfig to fix it.

Fixes: a9af47e382a4 ("iommufd/selftest: Test IOMMU_HWPT_GET_DIRTY_BITMAP")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240327182050.GA1363414@ziepe.ca
Tested-by: Muhammad Usama Anjum <usama.anjum@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of the `IOMMUFD_DRIVER` symbol being automatically included in certain configurations, specifically when the `IOMMUFD_TEST` option was enabled. This omission led to the failure of sub-functions related to dirty tracking, which are essential for the proper functioning of the self-test suite. Without the driver being selected, the necessary functionality for testing was not available, resulting in test failures.

Here is the patch:
 	depends on FAULT_INJECTION
 	depends on RUNTIME_TESTING_MENU
+	select IOMMUFD_DRIVER
 	default n
 	help
